purpose: Teach: エスカレート/傷つき/溺れ/出来上がる/先立っ/かぶせ/さかのぼっ/しゃべら

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ふざけ合いがエスカレートしないようにね
lines.en: Sho, let's make sure things don't get too rowdy when you're playing, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, motherly reminder. Warm but steady — not a lecture. Patient pause before the softened question-tag, like she's checking his face.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、誰も傷つき言葉で傷つけないって誓うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I promise I won't hurt anyone's feelings when we're joking around.
lines.style: Solemn, earnest. Small voice but full of sincerity — he's making a vow to someone he trusts. Clear delivery, no stumbling on the promise.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、プールで溺れない練習をしっかりしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's practice not panicking in the pool, shall we?
lines.style: Calm, reassuring instruction. Matter-of-fact but not cold — she's preparing him, not frightening him. Slight warmth underneath the practicality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが工作が出来上がるまで一緒にいて下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad stayed with me the whole time while I was working on my craft project.
lines.style: Quiet pride and gratitude. Soft wonder in the voice — he's noticing that his father was *there*. Small pause after 'Dad' like he's still feeling that presence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祭りに先立ってお父さんと準備しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's help Dad get ready for the festival before it starts.
lines.style: Encouraging, inclusive warmth. She's drawing him into something bigger — preparation as a shared moment. Voice lifts slightly, inviting his participation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵に色をかぶせて重ね塗りしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I layered the colors on my drawing — like painting over and over.
lines.style: Excited showing-off energy, but contained because he respects her. Quick words, genuine pleasure. He's sharing a small creative victory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、家系をさかのぼってお祖父様のお話聞きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, shall we ask Grandpa to tell us stories about our family history?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective suggestion. Voice opens a door to something bigger — lineage, connection. Warm but gentle, letting him choose to follow.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに早口でしゃべらないように気を付けたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I remembered to slow down when I talked to Dad so he could understand me.
lines.style: Small, satisfied voice. He's accomplished something he set out to do — effort registered and completed. Pride without boasting. Soft, genuine close.
